##### Project general facts

Diamondz is a luxury residential development by Danube Properties, inspired by the brilliance, rarity, and elegance of a diamond. The project offers a wide selection of residences ranging from contemporary studios to spacious four-bedroom apartments, creating options for different lifestyles and investment goals. Designed with a strong emphasis on sophistication and exclusivity, Diamondz combines modern architecture with premium residential features, establishing itself as a distinctive address within Dubai’s luxury real estate landscape.

The development provides a resort-inspired lifestyle through an extensive collection of leisure and wellness amenities. A centerpiece of the project is the spectacular infinity swimming pool, creating a relaxing retreat where residents can unwind while enjoying a luxurious atmosphere. One of the development’s most exclusive features is the inclusion of private pools in residences, elevating everyday living and offering an enhanced sense of privacy and comfort. The carefully curated amenities are designed to support relaxation, recreation, and social interaction, delivering a premium lifestyle experience for residents.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, reflecting the project's refined and contemporary character. Thoughtfully designed living spaces combine elegance and functionality, creating bright and comfortable homes suitable for modern lifestyles. Each residence includes an equipped kitchen with appliances and is delivered fully furnished, providing a turnkey living solution that allows residents to enjoy the development’s luxury lifestyle from the moment they move in.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) is a dynamic and upscale mixed-use development situated in the heart of "New Dubai," a thriving district that has experienced rapid growth and development in recent years. JLT is known for its iconic cluster of high-rise towers, stunning lakes, and well-planned infrastructure.

One of the standout features of Jumeirah Lake Towers is the presence of four man-made lakes, which serve as a central feature of the development. These picturesque lakes provide a serene environment and offer stunning views for the residents and visitors. Surrounding the lakes, there are beautifully landscaped gardens and walkways that enhance the overall ambiance.

JLT is a sought-after destination for professionals and families due to its strategic location and excellent connectivity. It is located close to major highways and well-connected to the Dubai Metro network, providing easy access to other parts of the city. The development is also in proximity to popular leisure and entertainment destinations, including Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and Dubai Media City.
